desc: Ideation: gap/parity characterization, greedy subsequence plan, and edge cases.
Implement the concise efficient Python solver using the gap-greedy algorithm, run the sample, and output code only.
Validate the solver against the public sample and key edge cases (single target, impossible span, parity R+1, A==B).
Finalize the submitted code as only the efficient O(sum N) solver, reading stdin and writing stdout, enclosed in the required delimiters.
